modules.name: Apply Vendors
modules.summary: ADM currently exposes Apply Vendors as a four-page capability: application review, interview calendar, interview-address administration, and QR application analytics. The application list is server-filtered, searchable, sortable, paginated, and grouped by lifecycle status. Exploration remained read-only and omitted personal row data.

modules.name: Assign Gigs New
modules.summary: ADM currently provides a live Assign Gigs New 2D interface at /assign-routes-new/ with service context, a paginated unassigned-route pool, driver/status/route filters, a driver table with three route slots, confirmation information, SMS actions, and server-backed list loading. A 3D child route is reachable through the header, but its visibly templated and differently sized dataset should be treated cautiously pending verification of its data source.

modules.name: Back to Pharmacy
modules.summary: ADM currently provides a read-only Back to Pharmacy worklist under Main navigation. It uses five server-backed return-state filters, search, row selection, pagination, and configurable page size to review orders and their parent-order and delivery-attempt context. No business data was mutated.

modules.name: Carrier Pickups
modules.summary: ADM Carrier Pickups is verified at /carrier-pickups under the Main navigation and active service-area context. It provides status counters, server-backed search, a detailed carrier-pickup table, and configurable page size. The observed ADM dataset had 12 records: 5 Scheduled and 7 Cancelled. No business data was mutated.

modules.name: Clients New
modules.summary: Access client management through the newer or legacy interface.

modules.name: Copays
modules.summary: ADM Copays is a context-sensitive operational queue backed by POST list and counter requests. It supports payment-method and lifecycle filtering, client/order/driver/hub/date constraints, pagination, CSV export, barcode-driven status controls, selection-dependent bulk actions, and read-only navigation into related order details. No business data was changed.

modules.name: Dispatchers New
modules.summary: View dispatcher staffing through the newer or legacy interface.

modules.name: Equipment
modules.summary: ADM Equipment is a context-aware operational inventory page at /equipment. It presents equipment in a paginated table with facility hub, type, and status counter filters, backed by dedicated list and count endpoints. It also includes modal workflows for managing equipment types, confirming printed labels, and scanning equipment labels. All exploration remained read-only and created no business mutations.

modules.name: Get Route Name
modules.summary: ADM currently exposes Get Route Name at /get-route-name. The page combines an Order Id scan entry with route cards and numbered stops, plus hub and route-status filtering backed by read-only route and hub endpoints. Filter behavior was verified live and restored to ALL/ALL; no business data was mutated.

modules.name: Gigs
modules.summary: ADM Gigs is a context-sensitive delivery-route dashboard at /routes/. It provides an ownership- and status-filtered gig list and a detailed /routes/{id} view covering workflow state, finance, ETA, map, assigned vendor, stops/orders, payouts, and activity history. All exploration was read-only.

modules.name: Lead Status Labels
modules.summary: Manage labels used for lead statuses.

modules.name: Manage address cache
modules.summary: Inspect or administer cached address data.

modules.name: Map
modules.summary: ADM /map is a delivery operations map scoped by facility, hub, date, client, status, and geographic bounds. In the verified Hawaii context it displayed delivery markers, region polygons, region order counts, Drivers/Regions/Orders sections, queue and optimization controls, map-layer tools, and AI route-planning affordances. No business data was mutated.

modules.name: Modal Notifications
modules.summary: View or administer modal notification content.

modules.name: New order
modules.summary: ADM New order is a client- and facility-contextual order-entry page at /orders/new. It captures recipient and prescription information, delivery and signature choices, package details, optional documents, and supports CSV/XLSX import. Recent orders are shown alongside the form. The module was fully reached and safely observed without submitting, resetting, uploading, accepting terms, or changing business data.

modules.name: Orders
modules.summary: ADM Orders was fully reached and observed with Hawaii selected. The page provides hub, status, and return-property filtering over a selectable operational orders table, supports pagination sizing and batch/export controls, and links to New Order and Orders Integrations. Filtering uses separate successful list and counter requests. No business or integration data was mutated.

modules.name: Orders STAT
modules.summary: ADM currently provides an Orders STAT queue at /orders/stat with status counters, a detailed paginated order table, and a related /orders/stat/map Delivery Dashboard. The queue returned 128 records in All during observation and loads data through dedicated getList and getCounters calls. The map filters by delivery date and status and provides status, client, driver, zoom, full-screen, and layer controls; the observed date/status produced an empty state. No business data was mutated.

modules.name: Pickups
modules.summary: ADM Pickups is a context-sensitive activity table at /clients/pickups with date/status/search filtering, sorting, pagination, CSV and refresh controls. It links to a client-filterable pickup map and a weekly pharmacy pickup schedule. Live requests confirmed count, list, map, driver, client, facility/hub, and schedule/group data sources. No business data was mutated.

modules.name: PrimeRX Orders
modules.summary: View orders associated with PrimeRX integration.

modules.name: QR Apply Analytics
modules.summary: ADM currently provides a read-only QR Apply Analytics page at /apply/analytics with date filtering, QR-city/IP-city grouping, targeted-only filtering, KPI cards, daily detail, aggregate city summaries and CSV export. Live UI changes were backed by successful GET requests to /users/apply-analytics; no business data was mutated.

modules.name: Quote Requests
modules.summary: ADM Quote Requests is verified at /quotes. It provides New and Reviewed request states backed by a POST list endpoint, with a table covering submission metadata, delivery volume, and six regional selections. All exploration was read-only; potentially mutating row actions were not activated.

modules.name: Reports
modules.summary: View reports available to the authenticated user.

modules.name: Scan | As Vendor
modules.summary: ADM currently exposes Scan | As Vendor at /scanner/as-driver through the Main navigation. The page provides a Barcode Numbers input and an Auto Submit on Scan radio setting that was On when observed. Facility and hub context were both selected as Hawaii, with live requests loading facilities and facility-specific hubs. No barcode was submitted and no business data was mutated.

modules.name: Scan | Unlock Vendor
modules.summary: ADM currently exposes the verified Scan | Unlock Vendor route at /scanner/unlock-for-driver. Its read-only observed surface is a barcode input under "Scanner | Unlock Route For Driver" plus an Off/On Auto Submit control, initially On. Facility and hub context are present, but the business unlock action and its API could not be safely exercised without a valid QA barcode and associated context.

modules.name: Scan New
modules.summary: ADM Scan New was verified as a shared scanning workspace with 16 observed routes spanning information lookup, printing, filtering, queue validation, and status-related workflows. Shared controls include auto-submit timing, voice/type announcements, hub QR checking, and an announcement settings modal. Scan by Filter loads status, type, activity, and hub metadata, while Ready for Delivery accepts barcode, vendor, or equipment identifiers. Exploration remained read-only and submitted no business identifiers.

modules.name: Scanner
modules.summary: ADM exposes the Scanner order editor at /scanner/order-editor. It accepts an order barcode identifier, defaults Auto Submit on Scan to On, and looks up the identifier through POST /api/order/get. Empty Enter did not issue a lookup. A synthetic nonexistent identifier returned an application error with no data, cleared and refocused the input, and produced two not-found alerts. No business data was mutated.
